quotes.text: It just returns a list of child folder names.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: discoverChildFolders returns only immediate child names. The test then builds folder objects, but getChildNamed itself triggers legacy folder discovery; the test comments warn that tricky names can be disturbed. Active cases cover empty/basic nested names in both stores, while escaped-name cases stay commented out. The original filename helpers were conversion-only stubs for separate compilation; fixed helpers are later implementations. Do not treat this discovery test as proof that escaped/reserved names round-trip independently of legacy discovery. No filesystem or platform test ran.
title: Separate direct store discovery from its legacy-assisted test hierarchy
